name: Spark Emoji
summary: Emoji and symbol picker on Meta+. Search in English and French, recently used, skin tones, arrows, maths, currency and accented letters.
summary_fr: Sélecteur d'émojis et de symboles sur Meta+. Recherche en anglais et en français, récents, teintes de peau, flèches, maths, monnaies et lettres accentuées.

optional.google-noto-color-emoji-fonts: colour emoji (without it they show as boxes or in black and white)

needs.system: Linux; any desktop. Pasting into the previous window needs a desktop with the RemoteDesktop portal (KDE Plasma 6 has it) and the person's OK; without it Spark Emoji copies
